cases.input: the 8 corners of [0,10]^3 plus 1000 points from mulberry32(seed 7) uniform in (0.5, 9.5)^3
cases.derivation: interior points cannot be hull vertices; hull = the cube; 6 square faces = 12 triangles

cases.input: torus R 5, r 2 (continuous); mesh torus 64 x 32 segments for the test
cases.derivation: hull = { |z| <= r, rho <= R + sqrt(r^2 - z^2) }; V = pi * int_{-r}^{r} (R + sqrt(r^2 - z^2))^2 dz = 2 pi R^2 r + pi^2 R r^2 + 4/3 pi r^3

discretisation.note: a mesh torus with nu x nv segments is inscribed; its hull volume is below the continuous value by at most about 2*deficit(nu) + 2*deficit(nv) (relative), deficit(n) = 1 - sin(2 pi / n) / (2 pi / n)
